curated_archetype_scope: Reusable identity contracts with concrete, stable visual evidence or deliberately authored permanent traits.
creation_gate: Create an archetype only when its permanent traits can be stated independently of one scene-conditioned presentation.
growth_policy: Add archetypes as separate identity contracts; keep scenes, poses, expressions, gaze, wardrobe state, and transient effects outside permanent identity.

tier_meaning.curated: A reviewed identity contract suitable for direct adoption.
tier_meaning.vocabulary: A retrieval aid that still requires semantic review.

domain_separation: Each archetype declares the subject domain whose morphology and expression channels it uses.
